topic: Getting on the Waitlist for Brunch

script.title: ON THE BRUNCH WAITLIST
script.scene_zh: 早午餐店 · 登記等位
script.story_hook: Brunch without a reservation, the waitlist way.
script.intro_zh: 沒有訂位的早午餐，用等位名單搞定。
script.welcome_en: Hello friends! Today we're joining a brunch waitlist.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們！今天到熱門的早午餐店排隊等位。
script.outro: Waiting smart is a skill now. Repeat and own it!
script.outro_zh: 聰明等位也是一種能力，跟著唸就學會了！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's go through it once more. Your turn.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們再來一遍，換你開口。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with honey-brown braids wound into a crown, wearing a denim jacket over a striped dress, juggling a crossbody purse and a folded stroller
script.char_b_description: a composed man in his fifties with steel-blue hair combed straight back and wire-rim glasses, wearing a sage-green host blazer with a gold name tag, holding a waitlist tablet
script.youtube_title: 【🥞🪟人氣早午餐等位英文】「傳訊息通知我們」怎麼說？登記、座位偏好、停車折抵 18 句｜🎧Brunch English
script.youtube_title_en: "You Thought of Everything" — Getting on the Brunch Waitlist
script.youtube_description:
週末想吃的早午餐店沒有訂位，要不要排？這集 18 句外場對話教你：登記人數與電話、請店家傳訊息通知、指定窗邊座位、兒童餐椅與停車折抵一次問好。自然美式口語搭配繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就會從容等位。

script.youtube_description_en:
Craving brunch at the hottest spot with no reservation? This 18-line host-stand scene covers joining the waitlist, asking for a text when the table is ready, requesting a window seat, and sorting out high chairs and parking validation. Natural American English with IPA plus a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🥞等位英文｜登記名單・訊息通知・座位偏好｜聽完就會排隊｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
週末的熱門早午餐店，沒訂位到底能不能等？
登記的資料、座位偏好、停車問題，要用英文怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進陽光滿溢的早午餐店門口，跟著顧客與外場從登記名單、請店家傳訊息通知、指定窗邊座位，到兒童餐椅與停車折抵，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📝 登記等位：例如「table for three?」、「Can you text when it's ready?」
🪟 座位偏好：例如「any chance of a window seat?」、「they have high chairs.」
🚗 貼心收尾：例如「we validate parking for waitlist guests.」、「See you soon.」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下一個悠閒早晨，安心喝著咖啡等開門！
script.thumbnail_action: signing the waitlist tablet at the host stand

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, table for three? No reservation, I know.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈteɪbəl fɔr θri noʊ ˌrɛzərˈveɪʃən aɪ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，三人座？我們沒有訂位，我知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're in luck-ish... forty-five minutes, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ɪn lʌk ɪʃ ˈfɔrti faɪv ˈmɪnɪts oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 算運氣不錯……要等四十五分鐘，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, that long? We drove across town for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðæt lɔŋ wi droʊd əˈkrɑs taʊn fɔr ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 呃，要這麼久？我們特地開車跨區過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fully booked, it's the last sunny Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʊli bʊkt ɪts ðə læst ˈsʌni ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天全訂滿啦，這是最後一個晴朗的週日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, we'll wait. Can you text when it's ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wil weɪt kæn ju tɛkst wɛn ɪts ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我們等。到時候可以傳訊息通知嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll text the phone number you give.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl tɛkst ðə foʊn ˈnʌmbər ju ɡɪv/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我會傳到您留的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. And any chance of a window seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ænd ˈɛni tʃæns əv ə ˈwɪndoʊ sit/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。有機會坐到窗邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll note it down: window for three.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl noʊt ɪt daʊn ˈwɪndoʊ fɔr θri/
dialogue.zh: 我幫您註記：窗邊三人座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Is there somewhere to wait nearby?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ɪz ðɛr ˈsʌmwɛr tə weɪt ˈnɪrˌbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！這附近哪裡可以等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee shop next door, they have high chairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi ʃɑp nɛkst dɔr ðeɪ hæv haɪ tʃɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 隔壁的咖啡廳就好，那邊有兒童椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my sister brought the baby actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt maɪ ˈsɪstər brɔt ðə ˈbeɪbi ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 剛好，我妹妹今天帶了寶寶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move. You've got about forty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt muv juv ɡɑt əˈbaʊt ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 那正好。您還有大約四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, parking's only two hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ˈpɑrkɪŋz ˈoʊnli tu ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，停車限兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we validate parking for waitlist guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz wi ˈvælɪˌdeɪt ˈpɑrkɪŋ fɔr ˈweɪtˌlɪst ɡɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，等位的客人我們可以折抵停車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of everything, honestly. See you soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɔt əv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈɑnəstli si ju sun/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，您什麼都想到了。一會兒見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll update the app if tables open sooner.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈʌpˌdeɪt ði æp ɪf ˈteɪbəlz ˈoʊpən ˈsunər/
dialogue.zh: 如果有桌提前空出來，我會更新通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. Thanks for making waiting so easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ θæŋks fɔr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈweɪtɪŋ soʊ ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 太周到了，謝謝讓等待這麼輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy those pancakes, you've earned them!
dialogue.zh: 好好享用松餅吧，這是你們應得的！
